sections.content_markdown: Work in pairs. Read the statements of the following grid. First match the parts in Column B with Column C to make complete sentences. Then make questions for the statements in Column A.

| Column A | Column B | Column C |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| What | 1. Despite the fact that Magura is a district headquarters, | a. besides his studies. |
| When | 2. His father was a sportsman | b. it is a small town. |
| How | 3. He encourages Shyam to participate in games and sports | c. in his student life. |
| When | 4. Shyam enjoys playing different games and sports | d. during break at school. |
| Who | 5. He walks | e. on different TV channels. |
| How long | 6. They walk | f. with his father. |
| Why | 7. He prefers programmes on nature and life | g. for their educative values. |
| What | 8. He watches sports programmes | h. for about an hour. |
Write about your own pastime following the model in G.
